summary: Aditxt, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a note purchase agreement, not a standalone special situation. The amendment allowed a new investor, canceled one note, and issued two additional notes with identical aggregate principal, maintaining the same secured debt structure. It involves no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. The filing is a routine financing amendment typical for ongoing debt arrangements. No special-situations category applies; the event lacks the transformative nature of the listed categories. It is a non-event for special-situations analysis.
